title: Telus Digital confirms a security incident after ShinyHunters claimed to have stolen ~1PB of data from the Canadian outsourcing giant in a multimonth breach (Lawrence Abrams/BleepingComputer)
summary: Lawrence Abrams / BleepingComputer: Telus Digital confirms a security incident after ShinyHunters claimed to have stolen ~1PB of data from the Canadian outsourcing giant in a multimonth breach — Canadian business process outsourcing giant Telus Digital has confirmed it suffered a security incident after threat actors claimed …
